meta.source: Warhammer 40,000 Balance Dataslate (official quarterly download, warhammer-community.com)
meta.description: Balance Dataslate tracking — how quarterly balance changes flow into The Strategium's data

authority.level: Official Commentary (canon level 2) — overrides printed codex rules, is overridden only by newer dataslates and FAQs

howChangesAreApplied.points: Baked into unit data automatically: tools/Update-RulesData.ps1 syncs points from Wahapedia CSV exports (which incorporate every dataslate) into WH40K/Data/Unit Data/*.json, then Supabase re-ingests
howChangesAreApplied.datasheetText: Wahapedia exports also carry ability rewordings — refreshed on the same pipeline
howChangesAreApplied.detachmentRules: Carried in the faction JSON detachments, refreshed with the same conversion pass
howChangesAreApplied.freshnessCheck: Wahapedia Last_update.csv timestamp; when it moves, rerun the pipeline

verification.note: This document records the mechanism, not the change list. For the authoritative change list always fetch the current dataslate PDF from warhammer-community.com downloads — per the rules authority protocol, never resolve a dispute from cached data when the official document is available.
